app.name: Glasopis
app.description: Free Bulgarian voice typing for Windows.

dictation.hint: Place the cursor in a text field and press {hotkey}.

overlay.clipboardOnly: The text is on the clipboard — press Ctrl+V.

general.title: General settings
general.startMinimized: Start minimized to the system tray
general.showFloatingWindow: Show the floating window while recording
general.playSounds: Play a sound when recording starts and stops

voice.title: Voice and recognition
voice.capitalize: Capitalize the first letter of a sentence
voice.commandsHint: Say „точка“, „запетая“, „нов ред“ or „нов параграф“ to insert them as symbols.

hotkeys.title: Hotkeys
hotkeys.modifierHint: Windows requires a combination with Ctrl, Alt or Shift — a single key cannot be registered globally.

insertion.title: Text insertion
insertion.explanation: Automatic mode pastes through the clipboard and falls back to keyboard simulation. Cyrillic is inserted correctly regardless of the active keyboard layout.

models.title: Speech models
models.intro: Glasopis needs a speech recognition model. The download happens once and is free.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.localText: Glasopis processes your voice locally on your computer. Recordings are never sent to external servers.
privacy.noTelemetry: No telemetry, no accounts, no subscription, no API key.
privacy.audioDeleted: The recording only exists in memory during recognition and is released immediately afterwards.

history.title: Dictation history
history.disabled: History is off. Enable it in the Privacy section.

about.title: About Glasopis
about.openSource: Glasopis is free and open-source software (MIT).
about.free: 100% free: no subscription, no API key, no cloud, no limits.

onboarding.welcomeText: Speak Bulgarian and Glasopis will type the text anywhere in Windows.
onboarding.micText: Pick the device you will dictate with and check the input level.
onboarding.modelText: The model runs locally on your computer and is downloaded once.
onboarding.hotkeyText: This combination starts and stops dictation anywhere in Windows.
onboarding.testText: Press the hotkey and say something. The text will appear in the field below.
onboarding.testPlaceholder: The recognized text will appear here...
onboarding.doneText: Glasopis runs in the system tray. Put the cursor in any text field and start speaking.

dictionary.title: Personal dictionary
dictionary.hint: Define how words the model gets wrong should be written. For example „гит хъб“ → GitHub.
